hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; base=$(basename "$f"); if [[ "$base" =~ ^\.env($|\.) ]] && [[ "$base" != ".env.example" ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing .env files is blocked by policy on this healthcare compliance project. Edit it directly outside Claude Code, or ask the user to confirm before proceeding."}}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm exec oxlint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true; }
